summary.name: OmniGraffle
summary.one_liner: OmniGraffle is a diagramming, rapid-prototyping, and vector design app from The Omni Group for Mac, iPad, and iPhone.
use_cases: Creating diagrams to explain complicated ideas
Rapid wireframing and prototyping of interfaces
Editing the same diagram across Mac, iPad and iPhone
summary.what_it_does: The page describes OmniGraffle as software for diagramming, rapid-prototyping, and design aimed at professionals who need to organize or communicate visually. Diagramming is presented as a way to explain complicated ideas, and rapid-prototyping as a way to build wireframes quickly. Design tools are described for creating vector graphics. Intelligent grouping, snapping, and alignment tools are mentioned for precise positioning. Mac, iPad, and iPhone can share the same stencils, projects, and JavaScript automation.
notable: Shared stencils, projects, and JavaScript automation across Mac, iPad, and iPhone
Intelligent grouping, snapping, and alignment tools for precise layout
Combines diagramming, wireframing, and vector design in one app
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
